presets.name: Scanlines
presets.fragment: vec3 colour = COMPAT_TEXTURE(Texture, TEX0.xy).rgb; float line = mod(floor(TEX0.y * TextureSize.y), 2.0); colour *= mix(1.0, 0.45, line); FragColor = vec4(colour, 1.0);

presets.name: Phosphor
presets.fragment: vec3 colour = COMPAT_TEXTURE(Texture, TEX0.xy).rgb; colour = vec3(colour.r * 0.22, min(colour.g * 1.25, 1.0), colour.b * 0.28); FragColor = vec4(colour, 1.0);
